headline: Mexican stock exchange registers sixth consecutive decline; accumulates 4.7% loss in the streak
summary: Mexico's stock indexes fell for a sixth consecutive session, in line with weak sentiment in peer markets abroad. The S&P/BMV IPC is down 1.65% so far this month.
why: The S&P/BMV IPC is the benchmark index of the Mexican Stock Exchange, so its moves signal broader investor sentiment toward Mexican equities.

impacts.name: S&P/BMV IPC
impacts.why: The benchmark index fell for six straight sessions and is down 1.65% this month.
